notes.title: Ooops! I'm sorry, users.
notes.content:
[b][h1]Hello We are Magoojabee Studio[/h1][/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42398450/4af851e75f43400fea17e9845b18cc19553cf2bc.gif[/img]

I'm sorry to meet the players with this news.
actually, today was the day Space Molmae started
But due to my small mistake, the release date has been pushed back by three to four days

[u][b][i]reason[/i][/b][/u] 
[list]
[*] I forgot to press the Steam Build button omg
[/list]

Yesterday, we checked this problem and pressed the release button, but we heard that it would take about 3 to 4 days.
apologize seriously... 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42398450/55902e14db5fbc4f71bc28ec68a6e52f75655771.jpg[/img]
But during that time we are synchronizing better services.
You can look forward to it.

Thank you
See you soon all!
